port.name: iTerm2
port.description: Living Code for iTerm2. Repository-owned theme files, installation instructions and four color flavors.

guide.installation:
Download a preset and `open` it; iTerm2 imports it and names the preset after the file. The command saves the files with spaces so the presets read *Living Code Night*, *Living Code Frost*, *Living Code Paper* and *Living Code Signal*:

```sh
curl -fsSL -o "$HOME/Downloads/Living Code #1.itermcolors" "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/living-code-theme/iterm2/main/Living-Code-{Night,Frost,Paper,Signal}.itermcolors" && open "$HOME"/Downloads/Living\ Code\ *.itermcolors
```

Then pick one under *Settings → Profiles → Colors → Color Presets*. Fallback: in that same menu choose *Import...* and select the downloaded files.
guide.configuration: See [iTerm2's documentation](https://iterm2.com) for application settings and reload behavior. The activation instructions above identify each supported flavor; keep your other application configuration.
guide.compatibility: This port supplies theme files for iTerm2, not the application itself. Install the application separately and follow the installation instructions for its supported configuration format.
